title: The Jungle School
summary: A school opens in the big, dark jungle, and all the animals hurry to see what's there. But who will their teacher be?
pages: Once there was a dark jungle.
It was a big, dark jungle. It had lots of trees and a narrow path. Many animals and birds lived there.

One day all the animals met. "Have you heard?" asked Tota the parrot. "Yes," said Hirni the deer. "What?" asked Darpok the rabbit. "We have a school in the jungle," answered Zhula the monkey. Mota the elephant wondered, "Hmm?" Lambu the giraffe said, "Oh, wonderful!" Dheema the snail piped up, "Quick, let's go!"

Tota the parrot flew first. Zhula the monkey jumped from tree to tree. Puraka the python slithered fast. "Here!" shouted Tota. "Can anyone read?" "I think it's upside down," said Zhula, who was hanging from a branch. Puraka summed it up: "Ssssss. Nobody can read."

Soon all their other friends joined them. Lambu peeked over the tree. "There's nobody here," he said. Zhula repeated after him, "There's nobody here." Tota suggested, "Look carefully!" Pilu the little bear cub announced, "I found a room!"
"I found a swing," said Dheema. "What are these blocks?" Darpok wanted to know. "What's this?" asked Zhula. Puraka explained, "I think it's a pencil."
Mota and Lambu found a classroom. They called to everyone, "Look, what's this?" Everyone came with schoolbags. They began to shout, "Teacher! Teacher! Where is our teacher?" Nobody knew.
Then they heard a roar. They heard a loud roar. They heard an even louder roar. Puraka was worried. Dheema was scared. Tota hid behind the board. Lambu and Zhula didn't understand what was happening.
Who is it? "Whoops!" said Zhula the monkey. Nobody spoke. Everyone looked at the teacher. From top to bottom, carefully. And then they looked at each other.

The teacher turned around to write on the board. "Jump," said Zhula. "Fly!" said Tota. Boom, boom, boom, ran Mota. "Run, run, run fast!" shouted Dheema. "Run awaaaay!" everyone shouted together. And when the teacher turned around... there was nobody in the classroom.
